query: INSERT INTO observation_parts (tenant_id, observation_id, namespace_id, access_level, revision, ordinal, byte_start, byte_end, model_id, embedding) SELECT $1, $2, $3, $4::smallint, $5, u.ordinal, u.byte_start, u.byte_end, $6, u.embedding::vector FROM UNNEST($7::int[], $8::int[], $9::int[], $10::text[]) AS u(ordinal, byte_start, byte_end, embedding)
